ratification.Q2_unscoped_be_basis: per-leg fill price (Lane B alternate: campaign average)
ratification.Q4_take_some_pct: 0.25 of current open (logged DESIGN_PCT, re-fit at n=15)

banner: NO BROKER ACTION - NO ORDER SUBMISSION - REVIEW-ONLY SHADOW PROPOSAL

pip_convention.note: project-established (forward ledger claim arithmetic); all engine math in decimal.Decimal

unit_convention.campaign_unit: 1.0 split equally across proposed legs; NO lot/contract/account sizing exists anywhere in this system

lanes.LANE_A: STRICT_FOLLOWER - the ratified defaults below, applied exactly
lanes.LANE_B: POLICY_SENSITIVITY - only the explicitly documented alternates below; NEVER labeled as Farouk's actual result

policies.rule: A campaign is created ONLY from a Farouk gold post containing direction + numeric entry zone + numeric SL (e.g. 45711, 45727). Commentary, watch-levels, results, other providers, indicator alerts: NEVER create a campaign.
policies.source: XAU-F001/F002 entry posts; sender gate (Farouk-only mutation); Cycle-006 contract
policies.consequence: zone-less trades are not followed (0 observed in 34-setup corpus + 2 forward)

policies.rule: One campaign per entry post. A second entry post = a NEW campaign unless it explicitly references re-entering the same idea. An explicit FINAL_CLOSE ends the campaign; management after close is annotation only. Ambiguous grouping -> UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED (NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, no proposal).
policies.source: F001->F002 separation rationale (ledger XAU_F_SETUP grouping fields)

policies.rule: Direction and zone boundaries are taken verbatim from the post (BUY/SELL; 'a-b' numeric zone; zone_low=min, zone_high=max). Typos preserved with note.

DEFAULT: 3 equal limit legs at zone near edge, midpoint, far edge (LONG: high/mid/low of zone; SHORT: low/mid/high). Farouk evidence proves multi-entry ('close worst hold best' 45714; 'Lowes entry' 45715; 001B tranche fields) but never publishes count/placement.
policies.consequence: follower average will differ from Farouk's private fills (F001: his implied lowest ~4015.5 vs our reachable 4019); accepted and documented

policies.rule: LANE_A: a limit leg fills only on trade-THROUGH (LONG: bar low < limit; SHORT: bar high > limit). Fill price = limit price. LANE_B alternate: touch-fill (low<=limit / high>=limit).
policies.consequence: Lane A conservative (fewer phantom fills); divergence surfaces as lane spread

policies.rule: If price is already inside the zone on the signal bar, the nearest leg becomes a market fill at the SIGNAL-BAR CLOSE; remaining legs stay limits.
policies.source: F002: signal bar in-zone, tp1 posted 8 min later (he was filled immediately)
policies.consequence: deterministic price; ~seconds of latency optimism, identical across campaigns

policies.rule: Legs fill independently; a campaign with any filled leg is live. Unfilled legs follow P14. Position accounting is per-leg (weight = 1/leg_count of the campaign unit).
policies.consequence: partial-zone campaigns (like F001, 1 of 3 legs) are first-class, not exceptions

policies.rule: Campaign average entry = fill-weighted mean of FILLED legs only, recomputed on each fill; recorded on every transition. Never uses Farouk's claims.
policies.consequence: auditable arithmetic; diverges from his private average by construction

policies.rule: His stated default 'TP1 ~ +50 pips' is RECORDED as context but NEVER auto-executed; only posted instructions move state (see P12). Rationale: he overrides his own default frequently (corpus).
policies.consequence: no phantom banking at +50p; follower acts on messages, not folklore

policies.rule: 'sl to entry' scoped to a named leg ('on lowest entry' 45717) -> that leg's OWN fill price. Unscoped 'sl to entry' -> DEFAULT: per-leg fill price on every filled leg. ALTERNATE (Lane B): campaign-average entry.
policies.consequence: material: per-leg scratches earlier on the worst leg; average holds longer. F001 single-leg case: identical. Multi-fill campaigns: lanes diverge

policies.rule: 'close worst' closes the worst-priced FILLED leg at instruction-bar close (LONG: highest fill; SHORT: lowest fill); 'hold best' holds the rest. SINGLE-LEG DEFAULT: close 50% of the leg (honours bank-something/hold-something intent of combined messages like 45714).
policies.consequence: single-leg choice moves banked fraction; multi-leg case is unambiguous

policies.rule: 'take 50% off' -> close 50% of CURRENT OPEN at instruction-bar close (allowlisted deterministic conversion, validator). 'tp 1'/'tp 1 now' with no level -> close 50% of CURRENT OPEN at instruction-bar close. 'take some off'/'take profit' with no pct -> DEFAULT 25% of CURRENT OPEN (ratification Q4). Non-allowlisted percentages NEVER invented.
policies.consequence: unspecified-pct choice shifts banked-vs-runner split; logged as DESIGN_PCT for re-fit at n=15

policies.rule: Remaining position holds until: FINAL_CLOSE instruction (exit at instruction-bar close), posted SL trade, or BE scratch (P10/P17). No auto-trailing, no invented targets. TP2+: only if posted as instruction/level.
policies.consequence: runner outcomes are pure consequences of his messages + price

policies.rule: Unfilled legs cancel at the EARLIEST of: explicit cancellation, FINAL_CLOSE, SL_TO_ENTRY instruction (DEFAULT: risk-off cancels resting orders), or 24h expiry. ALTERNATE (Lane B): keep resting until close/expiry.
policies.consequence: decisive in F002: deep legs traded 14:34/15:06 AFTER his 13:54 BE - Lane A never owns them, Lane B does

policies.rule: Re-entry only on an explicit new Farouk post; attempt counter increments per campaign idea; attempts >=3 are NOT proposed (flagged SKIPPED_BY_R2_CAP). Attempt 2 proposed with flag.
policies.source: R2 'PROMISING' verdict, winner_loss_comparison_v1.json (removes attempt-5 SL loss J17)
policies.consequence: occasionally skips a winner (J29, attempt 3); removes documented tail losses

policies.rule: No fill before FINAL_CLOSE/cancel/24h -> campaign closes NO_FILL. Never chase price outside the zone. No re-entry proposal after a NO_FILL expiry unless Farouk posts a new zone ('no-re-entry-after-range').
policies.source: 45684 (he treats missed zone as no trade)

policies.rule: Adjudication feed = Pepperstone 1m UTC. LANE_A: any touch of stop/BE level = event (stop-first, see P18). LANE_B: breach <= $3.00 beyond the level = survives (graze tolerance), > $3.00 = event at the level. All grazes logged AMBIGUOUS_FILL_BAND regardless of lane.

Within a single 1m bar, adverse events resolve FIRST (stop/BE before profit) - 'stop-first-on-touch'. Any decision that depends on intra-bar ordering is additionally tagged AMBIGUOUS_SEQUENCE. Entry messages landing intra-bar use bar close (P06) and are tagged.
policies.consequence: systematically conservative; never flatters the follower

policies.rule: Instructions bind only legs FILLED at instruction time. Later fills (Lane B keep-resting) carry the posted SL only; prior BE/partial instructions do NOT apply retroactively.

Contradictory or unparseable instructions -> campaign state PAUSED_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW; no proposal transition; nothing invented. Resolution requires a later clarifying Farouk post or Martyn review note (annotation, not execution).
Shared posted SL binds all legs (single SL per campaign is his universal format). Claimed personal stops are stored as annotations ONLY and never enter follower state.
Explicit cancellation/no-trade language cancels unfilled legs immediately; filled legs continue under last instructions.

Every field not derivable from posts + price data is UNKNOWN/null - never estimated. Fields that MUST remain unknown: Farouk's fills, personal stops, sizing, remaining personal fraction, A-grade internals.

No proposal/ledger record may contain: lot size, account risk, account balance, broker route, account ID, credentials, execution permission, order-submission fields. Enforced by the existing extended forbidden-token guard + engine-level scan.

acknowledgement_note: Martyn's review decision is an annotation with ZERO execution consequence; no state transition depends on it except the card's display state.
